tools.name: getBuckyMcpGuide
tools.description: Call with no arguments on first contact. Optional `role`, `market`, and `scale` answer the first-call questions on a second call. Returns what this session should do next.

tools.name: explainFeasibilityStatus
tools.description: Explain one Bucky coverage or per-fact provenance status and the safe next action. This is a pure static lookup: it does not inspect an address, retrieve property data, or call a database,, geocoder, AI model, or third-party API. Accepts exactly one of: live, live_unavailable, planned_not_live, geo_d

tools.name: getFeasibilitySnapshot
tools.description: Look up lot, zone, and building envelope for one street address in Canada or the US. Pass `address`. One address per call; cannot search or compare. CMHC rental survey figures describe purpose-built rentals; the new-build proxy is the 2000 or later band. Missing facts are not surveyed or unavailable

tools.name: getBylawSection
tools.description: Return the stored bylaw section text behind a snapshot citation. Pass `sectionIds` copied from `citations.*.knowledgeSectionId` on getFeasibilitySnapshot. Or pass `geoDivisionId` from `coverage.geoDivisionId`, `zoneCode` from `zone.code`, and `sectionNumbers` such as 3.1 or 3.2. The markdown is the

tools.name: screenLots
tools.description: Find the lots in one live Bucky city that match a list. Pass `city` or `geoDivisionId` with `thesis` (plain words), `criteria` (square feet, dollars), or both; or pass a saved `profileId`. Returns countOutcome (exact, partial, at_least, estimate, or unavailable), screeningRunId, and selected lots ra

tools.name: findPlacesByMarket
tools.description: Find which places to look at by their rental market: filter and rank the places Bucky sells (reviewed catalogue places) on market facts and signals. Signed-in only; read scope. Pass `country` (CA has data today) and a `preset` (CA: tight-rental, fast-rent-growth, undersupplied, mli-select-headroom),

tools.name: listSaved
tools.description: List the signed-in user’s saved lots and projects. Returns at most limit rows (default 50, maximum 200), with folder ids and project stages. Use folderId to read one private folder. Copy a lot entry’s id as savedLotId when filing it; lotId identifies its parcel. A saved lot is not a project.

tools.name: saveLot
tools.description: Save one parcel by lotId without creating a project or running analysis. Saving it again keeps the same save. Use preview=true first to inspect the request without writing.

tools.name: unsaveLot
tools.description: Unsave one parcel by lotId. This also removes that saved lot from every folder. Projects are kept. Use preview=true first; this MCP tool does not provide Undo.

tools.name: listSavedFolders
tools.description: List the signed-in user’s private folders, most recently used first, with item counts. Returns at most limit rows (default 50, maximum 200). Folders can contain saved lots and projects from different places.

tools.name: createSavedFolder
tools.description: Create a named private folder. A repeated create makes another folder. Use preview=true first and listSavedFolders to check an uncertain outcome before retrying.

tools.name: renameSavedFolder
tools.description: Rename a private folder by folderId. Pass name and use preview=true first to inspect the request without writing.

tools.name: deleteSavedFolder
tools.description: Delete a private folder by folderId and remove its memberships. Its lots stay saved and its projects are kept. Use preview=true first; this MCP tool does not restore deleted folders.

tools.name: addSavedFolderItem
tools.description: Add exactly one saved lot or project to a private folder. Pass folderId and target with savedLotId (a save id from listSaved) or projectId. Repeating the same membership is safe. Use preview=true first.

tools.name: removeSavedFolderItem
tools.description: Remove exactly one saved lot or project from a private folder. Pass folderId and target with savedLotId or projectId. The lot stays saved and the project is kept. Use preview=true first.

tools.name: runFeasibilityAnalysis
tools.description: Enqueue a fresh deterministic analysis run for a saved project. Pass `projectId`, or `project` with the name the user said; with neither, the result lists their projects and nothing is queued. Returns immediately with `agentStatus` (`queued`, `running`, `current`, `failed`, or `none`) and a receipt

tools.name: getProjectContext
tools.description: Load one project with analysis envelope, compact agentStatus, document summaries, evidence summaries, the project memory digest, and external_ref when the project was imported from another system. Pass `include` for optional sections: tasks, members, insights, capital, visualEvidence. Default is non

tools.name: saveToProject
tools.description: Create a project (`create`), attach lots (`attach_parcels`), or attach a knowledge reference (`attach_reference`). Pass `projectId` or `project`; with neither, the result lists projects and writes nothing. For attach_parcels, pass a WGS84 GeoJSON polygon (up to 500 selected parcels), or copy `lot.pa

tools.name: updateProject
tools.description: Patch project metadata (name, lifecycle status, externalRef). Pass `projectId`, or `project` with the name the user said; with neither, the result lists their projects and nothing is written. preview=true returns the field-level diff and writes nothing. A write returns a receipt; undoOperationId res

tools.name: setProjectMapListing
tools.description: Put a project on the public Bucky map, or take it off. Pass `projectId`, or `project` with the name the user said; with neither, the result lists their projects and nothing is published. Listing publishes the build-lot centroid, the project name, its zone category, typology and lifecycle status to a

tools.name: produceProjectReport
tools.description: Compose a project report PDF. Pass `projectId` or `project`; with neither, the result lists projects and no meter is spent. preview=true composes without spending. confirm=true exports, spends records.exports, and is irreversible. Returns a signed download URL, never PDF bytes.

tools.name: submitBuckyFeedback
tools.description: Open a human-reviewed feedback form and submit it to the Bucky product team. Call only when the user explicitly asks to send feedback, report a problem, suggest an improvement, or praise something. The server asks the MCP client to show the form; nothing is saved unless the human accepts it. Do not

tools.name: previewSiteCoverage
tools.description: Free preview, no sign-in needed. For one street address in Canada or the US, it says whether Bucky covers the place and which zoning facts it holds for the lot (lot boundary, zone, height, density, setbacks, permitted uses, overlays, parking): found, partly on file, or not on file. It returns no val

tools.name: cityInventory
tools.description: Public city catalogue inventory. Pass exactly one of: cityName, lat and lng together, or geoDivisionId. A city name with multiple matches returns choices; after the user chooses, call again with that candidate geoDivisionId. Never pass a slug. Shows datasets grouped by topic as on file, not loaded y

tools.name: uiGetAnalysisStatus
tools.description: Return only the analysis `agentStatus` for a project. Cheap enough to poll. Used by the Bucky app view; the model should call getProjectContext instead.
